title: 已完结热门小说推荐
content:
辫子世界。方言睁开眼睛，眼神里再无迷茫，全是兴奋之色。本来还在担心，该怎么在这个残酷的世界中活下去，三无任务系统是指望不上了，只能靠自己小心翼翼经营。现在好了，没想到居然还有同时穿越，共享记忆这么一个近乎于作弊的金手指，总算可以稍微放心一点了！方言乐滋滋的回想着武侠方言给他共享的记忆，整理着“自”身所学。一门内功混元功，一门掌法混元掌，两门剑法养吾剑法和希夷剑法！有了武侠方言的基础打底，辫子世界的方言好像多了好几年的武学经验。除了内功还需要水磨工夫细细打磨之外，方言只要勤加锻炼，让自己的身体素质提升上来就好。好在这个世界的自己只有六岁，还有大把的时间可以发育。春去秋来，寒来暑往。在大伯方德家里一直待了十几年，读书习武，方言终于长成一个弱冠青年！辫子朝的方言，辫子头的青年帅哥实在是太难找了，大家凑合看吧虽然实力有了很大的进步，但是方言再也没有去过那个意识空间。他隐隐约约明白原因，好像在等到这个世界的剧情开始之前，自己都没有办法再进入意识空间了。不过方言倒也是没闲着，既然意识空间进不去，那就自己修炼。修炼之余，方言也一直在调查当年导致自己家破人亡的原因。怎么说呢，如果以一个局外人的角度来看，方言他爹方之航算得上死有余辜。他勾结了红花会的大当家于万亭，将杭州府的赋税银子送京的时间和路线透露给了红花会的好汉们。然后赋税银子就被劫了。朝廷派下钦差方式舟来调查此事，方之航在狱中畏罪自杀。当然，在红花会的众好汉口中，方之航是为了不出卖红花会，这才选择自尽的。这十几年来，方言一直被灌输着要好好习武吗，报杀父灭门之仇。在大伯方德和红花会看来，方言的仇人是钦差方式舟和满清皇帝乾隆。不过方言自己倒是有不同的看法。兼听则明偏听则暗，乾隆帝和钦差方式舟固然是仇人，但是红花会也未必是自己人！所以方言这十几年来，尽量没有和红花会扯上关系。但是他的大伯却是红花会的忠实拥趸，一直和红花会在暗中来往。这不，这天傍晚，方德回来之后，就忧心忡忡的坐在厅堂里，长吁短叹。

“老爷，今日这是怎么了，为何唉声叹气的，竟连晚饭也不吃了？”苗翠花坐在方德下首，大大咧咧的问道。堂下的方言也是竖起了耳朵。方德本就没有打算避着方言，长叹一口气说道：“红花会总舵主大限已至，恐怕就是这几天的事情了！”苗翠花无所谓道：“于老舵主年事已高，能活到今日也算是寿长了，这又如何，左右不关我们家的事！”苗翠花一直以来都不喜红花会，方德家的绸缎庄，规模在整个广州也算数一数二，可是绸缎庄的绝大部分盈利，都被方德交给了红花会。如果不是这样的话，那方家在广州也能成为一方富豪，而不是像现在一样，只是勉强能算富足。“妇人之见！”方德气的吹胡子瞪眼，但是深知自己老婆性格的他也没有多说什么，只是叹了口气解释道，“我哪是担心这个啊，我是担心红花会今后的出路！红花会七万弟子，如果没有于老舵主统领大局，不知道还会出什么乱子！”“难道红花会就不能选出一个新舵主吗？”苗翠花奇怪的问道。“问题就出在这儿！”方德叹了口气说道，“按照于老舵主的意思，红花会下一任舵主已经有了人选。但是这个人选，是一个和红花会完全没有关系的年轻人！这如何能够服众啊？！！现在，红花会内部分成了两派，一派支持于老舵主属意的那个叫做陈家洛的年轻人，另一派则支持于老舵主的独子于振海！”“那还用说，当然选于振海啦！”苗翠花理所当然的说道。“自古以来都是父死子继，除了于振海，还有谁能继承红花会？！！”“红花会不是个普通的江湖门派，总舵主的选择当然不能这么儿戏！于振海这个人我知道，志大才疏，总舵主之位要是交给了他，那红花会就真的完了！”“那那个陈家洛呢？他难道是什么大英雄大豪杰吗？”苗翠花问道。“是啊，陈家洛是大臣陈世倌之子，天下第一高手天池怪侠袁士霄的爱徒，文武全才，风度翩翩，重情重义，确实是一个不可多得的人才！”方德解释道，“所以这就就是为难之处，陈家洛少年英杰，可惜不能服众。于振海倒是有根基，可是却难当大用！”“不管怎么说，这些和我们也没关系！”苗翠花没好气的翻了个白眼，“反正不管谁当了总舵主，我们该给的钱一分也不少！”“话不能这么说！”方德摇头叹息道，“以于振海的性子，若是他当了总舵主，我们家的进贡，恐怕还满足不了他的胃口！”“那就支持陈家洛喽！”苗翠花说道，“你也说他老子是当朝大员，应该不会缺钱吧！”“我也是这么想的，所以我得收拾一下准备北上！”方德说道。“北上？！！”苗翠花的声音陡然提高，“北上干什么？北上干什么？老爷你自己的身子你自己不清楚吗？哪里经得起长途跋涉？！！”“不行，必须要北上啊！”方德叹息道，“我这边有红花会广州分会的兄弟名单，必须送到那位少舵主的手中，如此方能表示我方家的态度！”“派个人送过去不行吗？”苗翠花还是不肯松口，“四当家夫妇不是在附近吗？让他们帮忙带一下不就好了？”“糊涂！”方德生气道，“这种事情怎可假手于他人？到时候功劳算我方家的还是算他奔雷手文泰来的？”“可是老爷你的身子……”苗翠花担心的说，“就没有其他办法了吗？”

辫子世界。Fang Yan opened his eyes, his eyes were no longer confused, but full of excitement.I was still worried about how to survive in this cruel world. I couldn't count on the three-no mission system, so I had to rely on myself to operate carefully.Now I'm fine. I didn't expect that there would be time travel at the same time. Shared memory is such a cheating cheat, so I can finally feel a little more at ease!Fang Yan happily recalled the memories shared with him by Wuxia Fang Yan and sorted out what he had learned.One internal skill is Hunyuan Gong, one palm skill is Hunyuan Palm, and two sword skills are Yangwu Sword Technique and Xiyi Sword Technique!With the basic foundation of martial arts dialects, the dialects in Braided World seem to have several years of martial arts experience.In addition to the internal strength that requires careful polishing, Fang Yan only needs to exercise regularly to improve his physical fitness.Fortunately, I am only six years old in this world, so I still have a lot of time to develop.Spring passes and autumn comes, cold comes and summer comes.After staying in uncle Fangde's house for more than ten years, studying and practicing martial arts, Fang Yan finally grew into a weak-headed young man!辫子朝的方言，辫子头的青年帅哥实在是太难找了，大家凑合看吧虽然实力有了很大的进步，但是方言再也没有去过那个意识空间。He vaguely understood the reason. It seemed that he had no way to enter the consciousness space again until the plot of this world began.But Fang Yan is not idle. Since he can't enter the consciousness space, he can practice on his own.In addition to practicing, Fang Yan has also been investigating the reasons that led to the destruction of his family.How can I put it, from an outsider's perspective, Fang Zhihang, Fang Yan's father, is worthy of his death.He colluded with Yu Wanting, the head of the Red Flower Club, and revealed the time and route of sending the tax money from Hangzhou to Beijing to the heroes of the Red Flower Club.Then the tax money was robbed.The imperial court sent an imperial envoy, Fang Zhihang, to investigate the matter. Fang Zhihang committed suicide in prison out of fear of crime.Of course, according to the heroes of the Red Flower Club, Fang Zhihang chose to commit suicide in order not to betray the Red Flower Club.For more than ten years, Fang Yan has been taught that he should practice martial arts well in order to avenge his father's death and his entire family.In the eyes of Uncle Fangde and Honghuahui, the enemies of dialect are the imperial envoy Fangzhou and the Manchu emperor Qianlong.However, Fang Yan himself has a different view.Listening to both will lead to enlightenment and listening to others will lead to darkness. Emperor Qianlong and the imperial envoy Fangzhou are certainly enemies, but the Red Flower Club may not be their own!Therefore, in the past ten years or so, Dialect has tried its best not to have anything to do with the Red Flower Society.But his uncle is a loyal supporter of the Red Flower Club and has been secretly communicating with the Red Flower Club.No, that evening, after Fang De came back, he sat in the hall worriedly and sighed.

"Master, what's going on today? Why are you sighing and not even having dinner?" Miao Cuihua asked carelessly, sitting under Fang De.The dialects in the hall also pricked up their ears.方德本就没有打算避着方言，长叹一口气说道：“红花会总舵主大限已至，恐怕就是这几天的事情了！”苗翠花无所谓道：“于老舵主年事已高，能活到今日也算是寿长了，这又如何，左右不关我们家的事！”苗翠花一直以来都不喜红花会，方德家的绸缎庄，规模在整个广州也算数一数二，可是绸缎庄的绝大部分盈利，都被方德交给了红花会。If this were not the case, the Fang family would have become a wealthy family in Guangzhou, instead of being just barely wealthy like they are now.“妇人之见！”方德气的吹胡子瞪眼，但是深知自己老婆性格的他也没有多说什么，只是叹了口气解释道，“我哪是担心这个啊，我是担心红花会今后的出路！红花会七万弟子，如果没有于老舵主统领大局，不知道还会出什么乱子！”“难道红花会就不能选出一个新舵主吗？”苗翠花奇怪的问道。“问题就出在这儿！”方德叹了口气说道，“按照于老舵主的意思，红花会下一任舵主已经有了人选。但是这个人选，是一个和红花会完全没有关系的年轻人！这如何能够服众啊？！！Now, the Red Flower Club is divided into two factions.One faction supports the young man named Chen Jialuo who is favored by the old helmsman, and the other supports Yu Zhenhai, the only son of the old helmsman!“自古以来都是父死子继，除了于振海，还有谁能继承红花会？！！”“红花会不是个普通的江湖门派，总舵主的选择当然不能这么儿戏！于振海这个人我知道，志大才疏，总舵主之位要是交给了他，那红花会就真的完了！”“那那个陈家洛呢？他难道是什么大英雄大豪杰吗？”苗翠花问道。"Yes, Chen Jialuo is the son of the minister Chen Shiguan, and the beloved disciple of the world's best master Tianchi Weixia Yuan Shixiao. He is versatile in both civil and military affairs, has a personable demeanor, and values love and justice. He is indeed a rare talent!" Fang De explained, "So this就就是为难之处，陈家洛少年英杰，可惜不能服众。于振海倒是有根基，可是却难当大用！”“不管怎么说，这些和我们也没关系！”苗翠花没好气的翻了个白眼，“反正不管谁当了总舵主，我们该给的钱一分也不少！”“话不能这么说！”方德摇头叹息道，“以于振海的性子，若是他当了总舵主，我们家的进贡，恐怕还满足不了他的胃口！”“那就支持陈家洛喽！”苗翠花说道，“你也说他老子是当朝大员，应该不会缺钱吧！”“我也是这么想的，所以我得收拾一下准备北上！”方德说道。"Going north?!" Miao Cuihua's voice suddenly raised, "What are you going north for? What are you going north for? Master, don't you know your own body? How can it withstand the long journey?!!" "No, we must go north!" Fang De sighed, "I have a list of brothers from the Guangzhou branch of the Red Flower Club here, and it must be sent to the young helmsman, so that we can express the attitude of our Fang family!"个人送过去不行吗？”苗翠花还是不肯松口，“四当家夫妇不是在附近吗？让他们帮忙带一下不就好了？”“糊涂！”方德生气道，“这种事情怎可假手于他人？到时候功劳算我方家的还是算他奔雷手文泰来的？”“可是老爷你的身子……”苗翠花担心的说，“就没有其他办法了吗？”
